lines.2026-09-30-latest-aliases: Call a family by a -latest id, like google/gemini-flash-latest. The newest live model answers; you pay for that one.
lines.2026-09-30: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol, BYOK through OpenAI: 1.05M context, 128K output, image input, $2 / $10 per million tokens.
lines.2026-09-30-solar-decide: Upstage's decision model returns structured answers, not chat text. 524,288-token context, $0.05 per million input.
lines.2026-09-30-liquid-d1: Liquid AI's first decision model: send state and typed questions, get calibrated probabilities, zero generated tokens.

headline: Latest aliases, GPT-6.1 Sol, and two decision models
share: AnyRouter changelog, 2026-09-30: -latest ids like anthropic/claude-sonnet-latest call the newest live model in a family. GPT-6.1 Sol joins BYOK through OpenAI. Solar Decide and Liquid d1 join the Decisions family. inclusionai/ling-2.6-1t is retired; the Ling-3.0 family replaces it.
rationale: The -latest aliases change how any request can name a model, so they lead. GPT-6.1 Sol is the largest model added. Solar Decide and Liquid d1 are a new kind of endpoint: typed questions in, structured answers out. The retirement is shown in the day's log and named with its replacement in the share copy, not given a spotlight, so it never reads as a launch.
